description: This file defines a PHP class 'LDAPEmployeeSearchFilterParams' which models search filter parameters for LDAP employee lookups within the OrangeHRM system. It contains private properties for various employee identifiers and contact details, along with getter and setter methods for each.

classes.name: LDAPEmployeeSearchFilterParams
classes.description: Data transfer object representing LDAP employee search filter parameters, including IDs and contact info used for LDAP queries.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number if set, otherwise null.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: getEmployeeId
methods.description: Returns the employee ID if set, otherwise null.

methods.name: setEmployeeId
methods.description: Sets the employee ID filter parameter.

methods.name: getWorkEmail
methods.description: Returns the work email if set, otherwise null.

methods.name: setWorkEmail
methods.description: Sets the work email filter parameter.

methods.name: getDrivingLicenseNo
methods.description: Returns the driving license number if set, otherwise null.

methods.name: setDrivingLicenseNo
methods.description: Sets the driving license number filter parameter.

methods.name: getOtherId
methods.description: Returns the other ID if set, otherwise null.

methods.name: setOtherId
methods.description: Sets the other ID filter parameter.

methods.name: getOtherEmail
methods.description: Returns the other email if set, otherwise null.

methods.name: setOtherEmail
methods.description: Sets the other email filter parameter.

methods.name: getSsnNumber
methods.description: Returns the SSN number if set, otherwise null.

methods.name: setSsnNumber
methods.description: Sets the SSN number filter parameter.

methods.name: getSinNumber
methods.description: Returns the SIN number if set, otherwise null.

methods.name: setSinNumber
methods.description: Sets the SIN number filter parameter.
